This assignment guides you to set up the working environment for the class and publish your work on your webpage. Do the follows

1. Download and Install R at [this link](https://cran.rstudio.com/) 
2. Download and Install Rsudio at [this link](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) 
3. Download and Install Git at [this link](https://git-scm.com/) 
4. Download and Install Github Desktop at [this link](https://desktop.github.com/download/)
5. Create a Github account and a repository
6. Publish a Github Page for the repository
7. Create a sample html named Assignment 1 from Rmarkdown or Quarto in Rstudio
8. Post/Upload the html file on your Github Page
9. Submit the link of your Github Page to Canvas

[This video]() shows how to do these steps (notice: the video is available after the first class).
